content: Hello! Youve reached onboarding support. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Im helping my son recover his accounthe cant remember his login details.
No problem. Could you provide his username or the email address linked to his account?
His username should be joshua.miller23, and his email is jmiller.family@email.com.
Thank you. Ive sent a recovery link to jmiller.family@email.com. Please check that inbox and click the link to continue.
We got the link and clicked it. Its asking for a verification code.
A six-digit code was just sent to his phone. Could you enter that code on the recovery page?
Done. Its now requesting a new password.
Great! Please create a strong new password for his account and confirm it. Once you submit, let me know if you see the confirmation message.
We set the new password and received the confirmation. Thanks for your help!
